content.text: Digital creators face significant barriers when trying to sell products online due to restrictions from platforms like Stripe and PayPal. Without access to these conventional payment systems, creators need a reliable alternative to process transactions effectively. A crypto payment gateway offers a solution that not only circumvents these restrictions but also reduces transaction fees, making it a more profitable choice for [[LINK:https://coremerch.github.io/store/blog/selling-digital-art-without-paypal-which-architecture-actually-8|COREMERCH guide to selling]] digital products like ebooks or courses.

content.title: How to Start Selling Digital Products with Crypto Payments

content.text: What This Actually Is and Why It Matters: Crypto payment

A crypto payment gateway allows digital creators to accept cryptocurrency for their products. Unlike traditional payment processors that impose high fees and require extensive verification, crypto gateways like NOWPayments charge a mere 0.5%. This enables creators to retain more revenue from each sale. In a world where traditional payment systems can deny access based on geographic location, adopting a crypto payment gateway becomes essential for maintaining financial sovereignty while expanding market reach.
How the Architecture Works Under the Hood

The architecture of a crypto payment gateway integrates various technologies to facilitate seamless transactions. At its core, it connects a digital storefront to a blockchain network. When a customer makes a purchase, the payment is processed on-chain, ensuring immediate verification and delivery. Using tools like Cloudflare Workers for backend logic and Google Drive for file delivery, creators can automate the entire process. This setup not only enhances user experience but also ensures that creators maintain complete control over their digital assets.
Who This Is Built For and Why

This solution is tailored for digital creators in regions where platforms like PayPal or Gumroad are unavailable. It specifically targets those selling ebooks, courses, templates, and other digital products. By leveraging a crypto payment gateway, these creators can operate independently without relying on third-party platforms that impose fees or restrictions. Whether in Nigeria, Venezuela, or other regions facing financial isolation, this infrastructure provides a robust alternative for monetizing digital content.
Save significantly on transaction fees with NOWPayments — only 0.5% per sale.
The Components That Make It Work Together

A successful crypto payment gateway is built on several key components. These include a secure hosting service, such as GitHub Pages or Cloudflare Pages, which serves the digital storefront. Backend logic is managed through Cloudflare Workers or Google Apps Script to handle transactions and automate product delivery. Order storage is facilitated via Supabase or Google Sheets, while NOWPayments processes crypto transactions. Together, these elements create a cohesive system that allows for efficient transaction handling and product delivery without reliance on traditional payment processors.
How to Use This Knowledge to Deploy Today

To set up your own crypto payment gateway, start by choosing a hosting service like Cloudflare Pages to launch your digital storefront. Next, configure backend logic using Cloudflare Workers to manage order processing. Utilize NOWPayments to handle cryptocurrency transactions and integrate an automated delivery system for your digital products through Google Drive. By following these steps, you can quickly establish a sovereign digital commerce stack and begin selling without the limitations imposed by traditional financial systems.
How do I sell an ebook online without PayPal or Stripe?

You can sell an ebook online without PayPal or Stripe by utilizing a crypto payment gateway. This allows you to accept various cryptocurrencies directly, minimizing transaction fees and ensuring complete control over your sales. Services like NOWPayments facilitate this process with low fees and no buyer account requirements, enabling efficient sales without conventional payment platforms.
Gain complete control over your digital products with no platform dependencies.

If you're looking to sell digital products without relying on platforms like PayPal or Gumroad, consider the Complete Builder Kit ($197). This comprehensive package includes all necessary blueprints and templates to deploy your own independent digital storefront. Check it out at https://coremerch.github.io/products.html.
Your Deployment Checklist

Build your product before you build your store — the product is the point, not the infrastructure. Once your product is ready and in delivery-ready format, create your NOWPayments account and configure wallet addresses. Choose Stack 01 for self-deployment following the Blueprint, or Stack 02 for COREMERCH deployment. Upload your product file to Google Drive or Cloudflare R2 and note the file path. Configure the product in your backend with the file path, USD price, and delivery email template. Build your product page on the storefront with clear product description, pricing in USD, and the checkout flow. Run a complete mainnet test. Check that the download link works and expires correctly after the configured time period.
Frequently Asked Questions
What are the advantages of using a crypto payment gateway?

Crypto payment gateways typically charge lower fees compared to traditional platforms. For instance, NOWPayments charges only 0.5% per transaction, allowing you to keep more of your revenue. Additionally, they offer a level of accessibility that isn't restricted by geographic limitations.
How does automated delivery work with crypto payments?

Automated delivery is achieved by integrating backend systems that trigger file delivery once a payment is confirmed. Using tools like Google Apps Script or Cloudflare Workers, you can set up an automatic process that delivers digital products immediately after successful transaction verification.
Can I use this setup for selling multiple types of digital products?

Yes, this infrastructure is versatile and can be used to sell various digital products, including ebooks, courses, templates, and software. The architecture is designed to accommodate different types of products and ensures efficient transaction handling for each.
What cryptocurrencies can I accept with NOWPayments?

NOWPayments supports over 300 cryptocurrencies, allowing you to accept various digital currencies for your products. This flexibility enables you to reach a wider audience and cater to different customer preferences.
How do I ensure security when using a crypto payment gateway?

To ensure security, use reputable hosting services and follow best practices for data management. Implement SSL certificates for your site, and regularly update your backend logic to protect against vulnerabilities. NOWPayments also adds a layer of security by processing payments on-chain.
